Name: Green spirit Linus -High Res Portraits
Author: Frostmachinecar
Description:
这个mod是 Looking for Love的替换文件,还有肖像
[i][size=5]请注意,如果你有其他替换精灵的MOD在运作,删除掉对应的Linus文件
安装指南[/size][/i]
1.安装所需的模块。
2.将下载的文件安装在 [CP] Looking for Love文件夹中。这一步不是必须，你可以直接替换掉其他的精灵文件
3.打开\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits
在上面的路径中[b]创建[/b]一个新文件夹,并在其中安装Linus.png文件。
4.在与角色对话时,按下P按钮切换并且应用肖像。

This mod is a replacement file for Looking for Love, as well as a portraitPlease note that if you have other mods replacing the sprite in operation, delete the corresponding Linus file1. Install the required modules.2. Install the downloaded files in the [CP] Looking for Love folder. This step is not necessary, you can directly replace the files of other mods3. \ Mods \ Portrait \ Portraits Create a new folder in the path above and place it in the portrait file of Linus.png.4. When conversing with a character, press the P button to switch and apply the portrait.
